Resolves #19584

The film's close now does what a desktop user would do with the hundred-thousand-row matrix: tear it out of the room (the existing `tear-out` cue, a window born under the hand, the same instance riding along), grow that window beside the room (a new `vessel-resize` cue: `NativeGestureDriver#executeVesselResizeStep` walks the frame through the vessel's owner-granted resize and position routes, a verified resize then a verified move per sample at the film's rhythm, the move carrying a native-effect identity so the dock reads the walk as a scripted effect, never a drag; the target frame derives from the main window and the display's available area at run time — `deriveVesselFrame` contains it within that area on all four edges, shifting it over the main window when the right side has no room, and records the clamp; a sample refused after effects began reports the frame as it stands, or names the readback that could not witness it), jump the matrix to its midpoint in that window, and throw it once: `grid-drag-scroll` gained `curve: 'throw'` (the samples share the travel eased in, quartic, so the stroke winds up and whips at the film's 33 ms rhythm and the addon's momentum reads the last hundred milliseconds' speed) — the x axis runs to the matrix's right room with the sparkline canvas column in view, the y axis runs two and a half times past the hand. The film ends side by side: the room breathing and the matrix streaming in a window of its own — the approved A6 close fits that unchanged.

The planned road home did not survive measurement (the ticket body records it): a vessel holding one item torn out alone has a tab-keyed detached record, so the dock's native return adopts nothing from it; the stack grip's return never settles; a window close is an undoable close, not a return; an undo of the tear-out leaves the emptied window open (the #19583 class). No road home is claimed (none verified); the native return's refusal now names the stack root and the drag record it found, and its settlement failure names what it saw.

Evidence: L3 (unit + headless e2e on the author's seat, own bridge) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3); AC-4 is the next take's frames. Residual: AC-4, Residual-Owner: #15252.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit + e2e ran.

size-guard-growth: apps/workstation/tour/NativeGestureDriver.mjs — one new executor (`executeVesselResizeStep`, the owner-granted resize + effect-tagged move walk with its named failures) and its frame derivation (`deriveVesselFrame`), 1148 → 1238 code lines (the refusal readback and the four-edge containment of the review's Round 1 included); the sibling executors live here by design (the dock's native-window seams), and the vessel-close executor written for this leaf was measured useless and removed.

- The close's tear-out is gated like every window birth (a third viewer gate).
